verdict.rationale: Reflect ships a built-in 'AI palette' (cmd+j) that can summarize notes, list action items, chat with notes, and run custom saved prompts, which is a real form of task delegation to an assistant inside the product. However, this is limited to text generation/summarization/chat over notes rather than broader agentic task execution (e.g., scheduling, multi-step actions), and there is no independent/hands-on corroboration of its performance beyond vendor docs. Missing for 10: evidence of the assistant performing multi-step or cross-app actions, and third-party/user validation of the AI feature's reliability.
